candidate: Certified exact vocabulary pruning for the BF16 lm-head
scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, vocabulary 248320, hidden size 1024, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, 192 real autoregressive decode states
mechanism: Cluster vocabulary rows offline and use blockwise L2 residual bounds to skip clusters that provably cannot contain the top-1 token. Also evaluate the stronger but non-executable oracle test that knows the true top-1 score and filters each row by its individual norm bound.
interpretation: The certified cluster index skips only about 0.027% of rows and costs more bytes than dense scoring. Even an oracle supplied with the true winning score cannot eliminate one row using the per-row Cauchy-Schwarz norm bound. No GPU implementation can recover a material gain from these bounds on this workload.
stop_rule: Do not implement these cluster or row-norm bounds on GPU. Reopen only for a materially tighter certified index whose p90 total-byte fraction is at most 0.75 on a larger hidden-state corpus.
